payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is the woman's jacket fully closed, with no visible opening remaining along its closure?
node.criteria: Pass if the jacket's front panels meet along the entire closure and no opening remains. Fail if any visible opening remains along the closure. Unknown if the closure is obscured or the image does not provide enough evidence to determine whether it is fully closed.
node.binding: Assess the same jacket and closure as in s1. Full closure is the requested endpoint; partial closure is not complete fulfillment.

dependencies.evidence: The jacket’s front is visibly more open in the edited image: a panel hangs away from her body rather than the front panels being brought together as in the source. It is not closed more than in the input.
